author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (knee) to undergo MRI Friday
desc: Zack Gelof is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Friday.
impact: Gelof has a deep laceration under his right kneecap following his early exit on Thursday. There should be an update on his status on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Lopez to open game for Athletics Friday
desc: Jacob Lopez will open Friday's game for the Athletics against the White Sox.
impact: Lopez was recalled from Triple-A earlier this week. It is unclear how far he'll go on the mound.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ben Rice goes yard twice, drives in five in win over Rays
desc: Ben Rice went 2-for-4 in Thursday's 12-4 win over the Rays with two home runs, five RBI, three runs scored, and one walk.
impact: Rice continues an explosive stretch at the plate, homering in five of his last nine contests. The first baseman remains one of the more dynamic bats in a Yankees lineup still without Aaron Judge and Giancarlo Stanton for manager Aaron Boone, carrying a .956 OPS with 28 home runs, 65 RBI, 63 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 88 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Caballero swipes base, drives in one in rout of Rays
desc: Jose Caballero went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rays with one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Caballero has heated back up at the plate, registering hits in five of his last seven contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the more streaky options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, slashing .246 with 10 home runs, 34 RBI, 35 runs scored, and 21 stolen bases through 80 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Max Schuemann swipes base, scores twice in win over Rays
desc: Max Schuemann went 2-for-4 in Thursday's win over the Rays with one double, one stolen base, and two runs scored.
impact: Schuemann has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in four of his last eight contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the more inconsistent options when in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, hitting .240 with two home runs, six RBI, 16 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 31 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jasson Dominguez steals base in win over Rays
desc: Jasson Dominguez went 2-for-4 in a win over the Rays with one run scored, one stolen base, and one walk.
impact: Dominguez has heated up at the plate of late, picking up hits in six of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the more inconsistent bats in a Yankees lineup missing Aaron Judge and Giancarlo Stanton, slashing .233 with four home runs, 10 RBI, 11 runs scored, and six stolen bases through 33 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Austin Wells homers in win over Rays
desc: Austin Wells went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rays with a home run, one RBI, one walk, and two runs scored.
impact: Wells continues a dismal stretch at the plate, collecting hits in just two of his last 11 contests. The catcher remains more valuable for his game calling behind the plate for manager Aaron Boone, hitting .151 with five home runs, 11 RBI, 18 runs scored, and one stolen base through 63 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luisangel Acuna swipes base in loss to Red Sox
desc: Luisangel Acuna went 1-for-2 in a loss to the Red Sox with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Acuna continues an underwhelming stretch at the plate, collecting hits in four of his last 11 contests. The 24-year-old remains one of the more underperforming bats when inserted into a streaky White Sox lineup for manager Will Venable, slashing .233 with one home run, 10 RBI, 15 stolen bases, and 34 runs scored across 66 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Anthony Kay solid on mound in loss to Red Sox
desc: Anthony Kay allowed two earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out four over 5 1/3 innings in Thursday's loss to the Red Sox.
impact: Kay continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in 10 of his last 13 trips to the mound. The left-hander offers manager Will Venable one of the more stable arms in the White Sox rotation, posting a 4.23 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 6-4 record and 7.2 K/9 ratio through 19 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Gibson dealing with illness
desc: Trey Gibson is dealing with an illness.
impact: Gibson will not make his next scheduled start with Triple-A Norfolk. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez (concussion) unlikely to return before All-Star break
desc: The Mariners do not expect Julio Rodriguez to be activated this weekend.
impact: Rodriguez landed on the concussion injured list last week. He'll likely be activated following the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia re-signs with Rockies on minor league deal
desc: The Rockies re-signed John Brebbia to a minor league contract.
impact: Brebbia tested the open market before returning to the Rockies organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Soderstrom battling hip injury
desc: Tyler Soderstrom is not in the Athletics lineup on Thursday against the Tigers.
impact: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Soderstrom is managing his hip as he returns from injury. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Goodman (hand) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Hunter Goodman is back in the Rockies lineup on Thursday against the Giants.
impact: Goodman returns from a two-game absence after injuring his wrist on Monday. He is back behind the plate and batting cleanup.
